name: Grand Canyon
source: USGS Grand Canyon National Park lidar (NAVD88 metres). USGS 3DEP public-domain lidar, Entwine Point Tiles: https://s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/usgs-lidar-public/AZ_GrandCanyonNP_1_2019/ept.json
facts: The Grand Canyon was carved by the Colorado River, which has been cutting down through the rock for millions of years.
It is about a mile deep. The rock layers in its walls are like the pages of a giant book about Earth's past.
axes: +X east, +Y up, +Z south; metres = int16 * scale; y = 0 is the water level
order: random (the first N points are an even subsample)
